discoveries.context_excerpt: Petros Lantzas, also known as Pietro Lanza or Pedro Lanza, was a Corfiot Greek born around 1533 on the island of Corfu. He became a rebel, spy, privateer and pirate who worked against Ottoman rule in the Balkans. He started his career with the Republic of Venice and from 1574 served the Spanish Empire. During the Ottoman–Venetian wars, Lantzas led raids on Ottoman ships, helped Epirus rebels, and played a role in several anti-Ottoman plots.
